items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: did you hear the record, thing we did with Duke, Louis' little band and Duke at the piano?

ctx.x: This is what he knew. Nobody could teach you that. These are things you try to watch and pick out, and I guess it took him years to become, to get to that point where he could really do that. But I watched him. I watched him like a hawk.

And John Hendricks told me he used to watch him just as hard. You know, John knows -- he knows what he's doing. He's no dummy, man. He said he watched -- he watched Louie, and he learned an awful lot from Louie. Anyone could. Duke loved him. You know, did you hear the record, thing we did with Duke, Louis' little band and Duke at the piano?
